items.text: Open curtains and ventilate the room where practical.
Check for belongings, damage, stains, missing items and maintenance problems.
Record and report problems immediately, with photographs where appropriate.
Label and secure forgotten belongings with the room number, date and finder’s name.
Remove rubbish and used toiletries. Handle sharp or suspicious items carefully.

title: Strip the bed and collect laundry

items.text: Remove all used sheets, pillowcases, towels and bathmats—even if they appear clean.
Check mattress protectors, pillows and bedding for stains, dampness or signs of pests; report concerns.
Keep dirty laundry separate from clean linen; do not place it on the floor.
Replace any soiled or damaged mattress protector.
Dust furniture, headboard, shelves, windowsills and other surfaces.
Clean frequently touched points: door handles, switches, remote controls and wardrobe handles.
Clean mirrors and visible marks on glass.
Clean inside drawers and wardrobes; check under the bed and behind accessible furniture.
Sweep or vacuum, then mop as appropriate, including corners.
Make the bed with fresh, dry, stain-free linen.
Use separate bathroom cloths and equipment; keep toilet-cleaning materials separate.
Clean and disinfect the toilet, including the seat, flush control, base and surrounding floor.
Clean the sink, taps, shower area, tiles and bathroom door handles.
Remove hair and debris from accessible drain covers; report slow drainage or leaks.
Clean the mirror and remove soap marks.
Empty and clean the bin; replace its liner.
Mop the floor and leave it dry.
Supply fresh towels, bathmat, toilet paper and the agreed guest toiletries.
Test lights, sockets visually, TV and remote controls.
Test the air conditioner; check cooling, unusual noise and leaking water.
Check water supply, shower, hot water where provided, and toilet flushing.
Check the room door, lock, windows and curtains.
Replenish the room’s standard supplies and arrange furniture neatly.
Switch off equipment or set it according to Tivoli’s room-preparation policy.
